about: What a world costs (Engine v2 O11, #2721): the one unit-price file. Every price has its date and its source; a price with no date is a bug (cost.test.mjs). The machine's size is the production machine's, from the owner's machine facts; its price is an example the owner replaces with the invoice.

machine.source: Example price; the owner replaces it with the invoice: EUR 79 a month, the low end of the dedicated-server row in v2/docs/machines.md, 'The goal, priced'. Size: the production machine's facts line of 18 Nov 2026 (v2/tools/ops/machine-facts.sh): 8 cores, 30.6 GB memory, 245 GB SSD

split.source: O11's default share of the machine's fixed price by part (#2721); the owner may change it

stored_bytes.source: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/ (storage A in v2/docs/machines.md; the free 10 GB is not netted out)

uploads.source: https://developers.cloudflare.com/r2/pricing/ (class A operations; the free million is not netted out)

bytes_served.source: v2/docs/machines.md, 'The goal, priced': the 10 Gbit link add-on's row (traffic past its 20 TB)
